fluff.overview: Infantry within the Legiones Marianes form the backbone of planetary garrison and territorial defense, freeing the Hegemony's limited BattleMech assets for offensive operations and prestige assignments. A triplus contubernium, or triple tent-group, combines three squads of ten soldiers mounted on light vehicles. Motorized triplus contubernia provide fast-moving infantry support for Marian armored columns and conduct sweeps across open terrain where foot infantry cannot keep pace. Support troops operate man-portable long-range missile launchers capable of engaging targets at distances well beyond personal weapon range, providing indirect fire capability against vehicles and fortified positions.
